main_problems.label: Computer turns on but the screen is blank
Computer gets hot or shuts down

q_power_led.text: When you press the power button, does the power LED light up?

q_fans.text: When the computer is switched on, do the fans spin (or do you hear the machine humming)?

q_power_cable.text: Is the power cable connected firmly to both the computer and the wall socket?

q_outlet.text: Does the wall socket supply power to other devices correctly?

q_computer_running.text: Does the computer switch on and stay running (lights and fans active)?

q_screen_blank.text: Is the screen completely blank (no picture at all)?

q_post_screen.text: At startup, do you briefly see the manufacturer logo or the BIOS screen?

q_external_monitor.text: If you connect an external monitor, does it show a picture?

q_os_loading_screen.text: After the logo screen, does the operating system loading screen appear (e.g., the Windows logo)?

q_bsod.text: Does the computer show a blue or black error screen while starting?

q_os_load_time.text: Does the operating system take a long time to start?

q_program_launch.text: Do programs take a long time to open?

q_disk_nearly_full.text: Is the hard disk almost full?

q_startup_programs.text: Do many programs start automatically when the computer starts?

q_computer_hot.text: Does the computer become unusually hot?

q_shutdown.text: Does the computer shut down unexpectedly on its own?

q_vent_blocked.text: Are the ventilation openings blocked or covered?

q_fan_noise.text: Is the cooling fan unusually loud?

q_wifi_connected.text: Is the computer connected to Wi-Fi?

q_networks_visible.text: Does the computer find any available Wi-Fi networks?

q_router_reachable.text: Can the computer communicate with the router (the local network)?

q_internet.text: Can you open websites or reach the internet?

q_other_devices.text: Do other devices on the same network also have no internet access?

q_ip_address.text: Does the computer obtain a valid IP address (not starting with 169.254)?

q_disk_activity.text: Is the disk constantly busy at high (100%) activity for long periods?

q_disk_errors.text: Does the system report disk errors?

q_ram_usage.text: Is RAM usage close to 100% even with few programs open?

q_freezes.text: Does the system freeze or become unresponsive?

q_ram_detected.text: Does the system show all the installed RAM?

q_device_detected.text: Does the operating system detect the device?

q_device_other_port.text: Does the device work when connected to a different port?

q_device_other_computer.text: Does the device work when connected to another computer?

q_driver.text: Does the system show a driver warning for the device?
